Original TailMixin, true nonlinear DN, residuals, boundary Jacobian, means,

prefix-tensor-diagnostic.scope:
Localize the original physical Cartesian Darboux tensor of an m3 prefix.

Uses the same exact angular chain rule and full 3x3 tensor as the original
950f adaptive audit. Also reports scalar Gauss/tangential Hessian defects and
an ODE-jet diagnostic at the same positions. The latter is not substituted for
the saved C2 interpolant, and is not itself claimed to define another surface.
All results are finite sampled diagnostics.

cartesian-seam.scope:
Compare full Cartesian two-jets in the same material angle and s direction.

Only one global rotation about z and one translation are fitted. No material
reparametrization or per-point alignment is permitted. Arrays stay in scratch.

prefix-envelope.scope:
Sample a reconstructed finite prefix's Cartesian radius, support and curvature.

No uniform enclosure is claimed. Material angular shifts and spatial rotations
preserve these scalar geometric quantities in the associated phase family.

numerical_limitations: Original M8 design tensor defect peaks in a quintic interval crossing an angular-spline knot.
Fixed-g M8 knot-aligned and tighter-tolerance run reduces this defect but does not remove it.
Tail M8 fullD stays about 2.35e-6, hence small metric and seam do not provide C2 convergence.
Full Cartesian cut comparison uses a fourth-order finite radial difference at h=1e-4 and finite angular samples.
Geometric reports cover only sampled finite prefix and 144 finite tail stages; no infinite nonlinear tail, cap, continuous reach, held witness or positive Euclidean quotient is certified.
